title: M I V Y
tagline: All-in-one: read, support, and publish with full ownership and total privacy.
description: We’ve built an all-in-one platform where anyone can read, support, or publish content with true digital ownership. Creators fully control their audience, data, and revenue, without the limits of traditional, centralized platforms. Fans enjoy a seamless and private experience, accessing free articles or subscribing directly for exclusive content. Every interaction—subscriptions, tips, upgrades—is executed transparently through smart contracts, ensuring fairness and autonomy for all users.
how_its_made: We used a Celo boilerplate in order to start developing the project, and we used AI coding with tools like Lovable and V0 along with Figma for the different front end components such as profile section, new article creation and landing page. We used React, Next, Typescript and Tailwind for the front end, and Convex for the database and backend.
